Ashwin: Heads-up: planning blue/green for router service tonight in eu-west1 during 23:00-00:30 UTC. Target upgrade v3.14 -> v3.15. Plan: create new pool, shadow-warm KV, ramp traffic 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 5m probe gates, then drain old pool. Rollback if error_rate > 2% or p95 > baseline*1.35 sustained 3m. @oncall-sre please monitor.

Ben: Curious about long-sequence perf on the quantized path. What did perf runs show?

Ashwin: Staging results: median similar, p95 up ~12% for sequences >1024 with current quant path. We'll limit early canary traffic for those sequences and enable KV prefix caching on v3.15 to offset.

Maria: Should we pin session affinity for the small cohorts? LB has stickiness but drain can flip things. Suggest pin cookie for 24h for the 5% and 25% groups.

Kai: Agree. Also recommend shadow traffic pre-warm for 5 minutes to populate caches. Use: `scripts/shadow_warm.sh --target router-v3.15 --rps 60 --duration 300`. Matches your warmup?

Ashwin: Yes. Explicit steps: 1) Create v3.15 pool (n=8) same autoscale 2) Run shadow_warm.sh 5m 3) traffic-split 95/5 for 10m probe 4) traffic-split 75/25 for 10m probe 5) shift to 0/100 and drain old pool, keep nodes on standby 30m. Command: `./routerctl traffic-split --service router --from v3.14 --to v3.15 --weights 95,5`.

release-bot: Release plan posted: https://redwood.internal/releases/plan/BRG-452. Artifacts pinned sha=4f3a2b1. Canary pings enabled. Auto-rollback hook configured for sustained thresholds.

Oncall-sre: I'll add temporary alerts for the window: `router.canary.error_rate > 2% for 3m` and `router.latency.p95 > baseline*1.35 for 3m`. I'll be on from 22:50->00:45 and will escalate to #incidents if triggered.

Ben: If we observe cache churn during old-pool drain, what's our fallback? Straight rollback or swap to a warmed variant?

Ashwin: Primary fallback is immediate lift-back to v3.14 and mark v3.15 on hold. We do have v3.15-compat (image with pre-warmed cache settings) as an intermediate. Prefer full rollback tonight unless it's a trivial config tweak.

Maria: I'll prepare a short release note for product and CS: "Router v3.15: better kernel selection, quantized long-seq perf fixes. Canary tonight 23:00 UTC eu-west1. Monitoring p95 and errors; rollback thresholds applied." Will post when deploy starts.

Kai: One more infra check: ensure CDN/cookie TTL won't cause sticky routing inconsistencies. Set cookie TTL <= 300s for the window.

Ashwin: Confirmed cookie TTL=300s for change window. Final preflight checklist: 
- Artifacts built & sha pinned (4f3a2b1) 
- Canary pool created and health checks green 
- Shadow warm executed 
- Alerts configured by oncall-sre 
- Product/CS heads-up posted by Maria 
- Eng-releases sign-off pending (:thumbsup:)

Maria: Posted heads-up in #product and #customer-success. Release note posted. :thumbsup:

Ashwin: Starting traffic-split at 23:00. Tagging deploy-bot to execute.

deploy-bot: STARTED BRG-452 router v3.15 rollout. run_id=rb-deploy-9022. Steps: create pool -> shadow warm -> split 95/5 -> probe -> 75/25 -> probe -> 0/100 drain. Reporting back to thread.

deploy-bot: CANARY(5%): shadow-warm ran 5m. Metrics: error_rate=0.22%, p95+11%. Proceeding to 25% probe in 6m.

Oncall-sre: Monitoring graphs now. p95 stable, error rate low. No anomalies so far. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: CANARY(25%): 10m probe passed. error_rate=0.19%, p95+9%. Proceeding to final 100% ramp in 5m.

Ben: Seeing small spike in KV misses but it leveled quickly after warm. Looks okay.

deploy-bot: FINAL: traffic shifted to v3.15 100%. Old pool drained and moved to standby for 30m. run_id=rb-deploy-9022. Change window closed at 00:18 UTC.

Ashwin: Thanks all. Keeping rollback hooks active for 60m. If anyone spots regressions, call it and we will lift back. :rocket:
